decks.notes: This deck focuses on disruption and efficient removal spells to control the game while using cheap threats and card advantage to maintain pressure. By combining hand disruption like Thoughtseize with tempo plays like Daze and Brazen Borrower, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing a board presence. Mishra's Bauble and Moonshadow provide additional card advantage, while Nethergoyf and Bilbo, Thief in the Night serve as early threats to pressure the opponent. The mana base is designed for consistency and to support the deck's ability to disrupt the opponent's resources.

The main idea of this deck is to use Cloudpost / Tron Ramp to quickly build up mana and control the game through powerful spells and creatures. The deck focuses on generating large amounts of mana with cards like Urza's Tower and Urza's Mine to play big threats like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Karn, the Great Creator. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Stock Up to help control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to dominate the late game with powerful threats and overwhelming mana advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Aluren to cast creatures for free and combo off with Acererak the Archlich and Stock Up to generate infinite value and potentially win the game in one turn. Show and Tell and Omniscience serve as alternative ways to cheat out cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo. The mana base includes City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb for ramping, as well as fetch lands to fix mana and enable card selection with Brainstorm.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using disruptive spells such as Force of Will and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's plays, while utilizing efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to apply pressure and tempo. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while keeping up a fast pace with aggressive threats and disruptive elements. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility and consistency in casting spells, while cards like Snuff Out and Fatal Push offer additional removal options. The deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through a mix of disruption and aggression.

The deck focuses on maintaining control of the board through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Daze while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Moonshadow. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while keeping a steady flow of threats to pressure them into making suboptimal plays. By utilizing a mix of disruption and aggression, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent, while also leveraging powerful spells like Force of Will to protect its own game plan.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing powerful Eldrazi creatures by utilizing lands like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple to ramp up mana. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt opponents' spells, while cards like Eldrazi Confluence and Glaring Fleshraker provide additional creature removal options. Cavern of Souls ensures the Eldrazi creatures can't be countered, while Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths offer card advantage and threats on the board. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-power creatures and efficient mana usage.

This deck focuses on using lands as a resource to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Life from the Loam, Wasteland, and Sphere of Resistance, the deck aims to slow down the opponent while generating value from lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. It also includes utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog for additional disruption. The deck can also use Crop Rotation to find key lands quickly. Overall, the strategy revolves around using lands effectively to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave. By utilizing powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and establish dominance early in the game. Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's strategy while Faithless Looting allows for card draw and graveyard filling. The deck is focused on comboing off and reanimating big threats to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disruptive creatures and equipment to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent's life total. By utilizing creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition, along with equipment such as Batterskull and Swords to Plowshares, this deck aims to disrupt opponent's game plan while building up a strong board presence. With the addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can generate additional value and resilience. The mana base is heavily focused on white sources to support the aggressive gameplay and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain momentum with efficient creatures and removal spells. It also has a mana denial strategy with cards like Wasteland and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, and then use cards like Dread Return and Bridge from Below to bring back powerful creatures like Ashen Rider from the graveyard. Cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Faithless Looting help to further fuel your graveyard, while Cabal Therapy allows you to disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of graveyard recursion and powerful creatures, ultimately outpacing and outmaneuvering them to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through powerful ramp cards like Cloudpost and Tron lands to accelerate into big threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. With disruption like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Grim Monolith and Kozilek's Command provide additional utility and flexibility in dealing with different threats. Overall, the deck focuses on generating mana advantage and controlling the game tempo to secure victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing strong creatures like Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, and Ocelot Pride to pressure the opponent quickly and efficiently. It also includes disruption elements such as Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck's mana base. The overall strategy revolves around aggressive plays and efficient disruption to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, while ramping up mana quickly with artifacts like Grim Monolith and Cloudpost lands. The goal is to get out powerful threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Karn, the Great Creator to dominate the board. The inclusion of cards like Stock Up and Kozilek's Command help maintain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's win condition is to ultimate Ugin or Karn, overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells and abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and spells. The deck uses a combination of hand disruption, counter magic, and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while using aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide card advantage and additional threats, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game and win through efficient and powerful plays.

The key strategy of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board by combining efficient removal spells with powerful disruptive spells and card draw. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to strip away key cards from the opponent's hand, while utilizing tempo plays like Daze and Brazen Borrower to disrupt their plays, this deck aims to pressure the opponent while hindering their ability to respond effectively. Additionally, the deck seeks to establish a fast clock with aggressive creatures like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Nethergoyf.
